evidence_receipt.falsification_condition: The code does not ignore nonempty parameter tokens without an equals sign; it simply skips adding them to params_dict, but does not ignore or discard them silently. The parameter is stripped and checked, but only tokens containing '=' are added to params_dict, so nonempty tokens without '=' are effectively ignored in the dictionary but not ignored by the function overall.
